hedge-bot.project_context: Liquidity bot that provides onchain liquidity via Raindex and hedges trades offchain via Alpaca. Includes hedging, rebalancing, vault management, order strategies, and the staging/production deployment infrastructure.

issuance-bot.project_context: Issuance bot that acts as the Issuer in Alpaca's Instant Tokenization Network (ITN). Implements the Issuer-side mint/redeem endpoints Alpaca calls, and coordinates with Rain OffchainAssetReceiptVault (SFT) contracts to mint and burn tokenized equity shares. Includes account linking, asset/token management, minting, redemption, dividends and corporate actions, new token launches, and the event-sourced (ES/CQRS) core shared with the liquidity bot.
